attribute-definition.description: Master switch for Message-Level Encryption. When enabled, the cartridge encrypts outbound requests (Request MLE) and asks Visa Acceptance to encrypt API responses (Response MLE), decrypting them with the private key alias below. Each direction also needs its own certificate configured. Disabled by default - enable it once the certificates are in place.
Alias of the "CyberSource_SJC_US" Certificate imported in "Private Keys and Certificates"for Request MLE.

attribute-definition.display-name: Request MLE - P12 file path under IMPEX (Option 2)
attribute-definition.description: Path under IMPEX to the Visa Acceptance .p12 bundle, e.g. src/mle/visaacceptance.p12. Used ONLY when Request MLE Certificate Alias (Option 1) is blank - Option 1 takes priority when both are set.

attribute-definition.display-name: Private Key Alias for Response MLE and Webhooks
attribute-definition.description: Alias of the Merchant P12 key imported in "Private Keys and Certificates" for response MLE and webhook decryption. This alias works for webhooks decryption even if Response MLE is disabled.
